name: index-explainer
prompt: Explain what a database index is to a junior developer, in under 120 words. Use British English.

criteria.description: Says that indexes slow down writes or take up extra space

name: late-delivery-email
prompt: Write a short email to a customer, Ms Patel, apologising that her order will arrive two days late. Offer her the discount code LATE10 for 10% off her next order. Use British English and keep it under 150 words.

criteria.description: Says the delay is two days and does not invent other details, such as a reason for the delay

name: book-as-json
prompt: Return a JSON object describing the novel Pride and Prejudice, with the keys title, author and year. Return only the JSON, with no other text.

criteria.description: Valid JSON with title, author and year

name: capital-in-one-word
prompt: What is the capital of Australia? Answer in one word.

name: function-naming-tips
prompt: Give three tips for naming Python functions clearly, as a bulleted list. Keep it under 80 words.

criteria.description: Every tip is about naming functions rather than general coding advice
